_doc: Delta ledger (tier-4 §5), both kinds. Append-only, one JSON object per line. Fields: asset, gap_id, kind (gap|opportunity), criterion, what, change, detector, owner, gate, state (OPEN|IN_PROGRESS|CLOSED|WITHDRAWN), ts. kind=gap: the shortfall against a requirement — `what` is written `measured: <figure, instrument, population> / required: <the gate's claim>` so the delta is a re-run, not a claim; gate = what it blocks (default: this asset's certification); CLOSED = the detector passed. kind=opportunity (tier-4 §9): the beyond — `what` = the distinction added or cost removed + expected delta; `change` = the proposal with cost and risk; `detector` = the measurement that proves it afterward; gate = NONE (an opportunity never blocks certification) and the row names the layer packet it feeds; OPEN=proposed, IN_PROGRESS=accepted and being built, CLOSED=realised and proven by its measurement, WITHDRAWN=rejected. A row with no detector/measurement is not registered — it is raised as a question. Rows without `kind` are read as kind=gap (pre-2026-09-26 rows).

what: measured: count_sql returns 741, of which 327 rows are produced by l0_yogas.py, l0_doshas.py and l0_dasha_systems.py / required: the cockpit credits an asset with its own rows
change: scope count_sql to this writer's rows, or declare brahma_ontology a multi-producer shared table in the registry
detector: per-class producer census; count_sql output equals the writer's declared row count

what: measured: asset_throughput.rows_written = 0 against 741 live rows, rows_per_second NULL, last_built_at 2026-09-04 / required: a build record carrying a real figure
change: instrument the seeder's run (rows, duration) into asset_throughput
detector: asset_throughput.rows_written non-zero after one build

what: measured: data plane 4.1 rule 1's detector is count(*) = count(DISTINCT canonical_id) ACROSS classes, which reports FAIL against data satisfying its own live constraint UNIQUE (entity_class, canonical_id) — 741 rows, 741 distinct composites, 0 duplicates / required: a detector that tests the authority's declared key
change: correct rule 1's detector to the composite key, or rule that the key must be simple — a sealed-document reopen either way
detector: re-run: the corrected detector passes on conformant data and fails on a seeded true duplicate
gate: layer packet W-L0-5 + sealed data plane reopen

what: measured: resolve_entity.ts returns two rows for the 11 ids present in two classes and applies a hard-coded ORDER BY (entity_class='varga') DESC preference — whose cited example, navamsa, exists in ONE class only, so the workaround addresses a condition not present in live data / required: consumers resolve on the declared composite key
change: make resolvers class-aware, or settle the key contract per opportunity O1
detector: join census: every consumer join returns exactly one row for all 741 identities

what: measured: no detector compares a row to its source_citation; 741/741 rows carry one / required: a source-correspondence detector that can fail
change: build the D1 detector (layer packet W-L0-3) and run it over this asset
detector: the detector reports a non-zero mismatch count it could also report as zero

what: measured: list_entities returns empty_reason stating entity_class='yoga' has no top-level class in brahma_ontology, against 233 live rows with exactly that class; dosha absent from VALID_ENTITY_CLASSES while matching 79 rows at runtime / required: a served surface's stated reason is true
change: delete the false UNBACKED_CLASSES branch; add yoga and dosha to the declared class vocabulary
detector: the 1.2 exposure census: reachable-and-declared 429/741 -> 741/741

what: measured: 79 of 79 dosha rows carry an empty synonyms array; the other 15 classes are complete / required: a non-empty closed alias set per entity
change: seed dosha alias sets through the writer
detector: per-class alias census: no_alias = 0 for all 16 classes

what: measured: normalisation is not declared at the authority; BPHS vs bphs is why 289 of 341 remedy source ids do not resolve / required: the normalisation rule declared once, at the authority, not at consumers
change: declare case and diacritic normalisation in the release; add the ambiguous-alias list
detector: remedy unresolved count 289 -> 0

what: measured: no declared universe for 11 of 16 classes; the text class and the corpus both hold 15 members and differ by 3 in EACH direction (ontology-only: bhrigu_samhita, jaimini_sutram, lal_kitab_text; corpus-only: bhrigu_nandi_nadi, bphs_jaimini, nadi_navamsa_patel) / required: a declared universe per class, and the two sets reconciled
change: declare the universe per class; derive the text class from the corpus (opportunity O5)
detector: the 1.1 width census re-run: 0 in both directions for text; every class carries a declared universe

what: measured: 0 of 2 capability modules serving this asset declare a density_contract (0 of 46 layer-wide) / required: declared where the capability paginates or facets
change: declare density_contract on resolve_entity and list_entities
detector: grep census over the L0 capability directory

what: the distinction added: one resolvable identity for all 741 rows, removing the defect class behind G03, G04 and the layer instance's mis-stated finding permanently
change: three options: (a) keep the composite key and make every resolver and join class-aware — matches the writer's intent and the live constraint, cheapest; (b) make canonical_id globally unique and rename the 11 collisions — matches data plane 4.1 rule 1 as literally written; (c) keep the composite key and add a generated global_id (class:id) for single-token consumers. Cost: (a) touches every join on canonical_id; (b) touches 11 ids and their referrers; (c) additive. Risk: (b) breaks existing references silently if any are missed. NATIVE DECISION, not an asset fix.
detector: join census before and after: 11 ids return two rows today, 0 after
gate: NONE — feeds the layer packet W-L0-5

what: removes the provenance ambiguity behind G01: the identity authority currently has four writers
change: either split identity rows so each class has one producer, or declare brahma_ontology a multi-producer shared table with a scoped count_sql per asset. Cost: registry change plus possibly three writer changes. Risk: low — no data moves.
detector: per-class producer census; each class attributable to exactly one writer

what: makes 312 built rows reachable and declared (233 yoga + 79 dosha) — 58% -> 100% of rows reachable-and-declared
change: add yoga and dosha to VALID_ENTITY_CLASSES and remove the false UNBACKED_CLASSES branch. [TRANSFERS] — the requirement belongs to the retrieval plane; the measurement is here. Cost: small. Risk: none.
detector: the 1.2 exposure census re-run

what: a real cost baseline where none exists: rows_written=0 today for a 741-row table
change: instrument seed_ontology to write rows and duration to asset_throughput. Cost: small. Risk: none. Output delta: none (same 414 rows seeded); input delta: none; build-cost delta: unmeasurable until it exists.
detector: the record carries a non-zero row count and a duration after one build, with output parity unchanged

what: fewer inputs and no drift: the text class duplicates what classical_text_chunks already knows, and the two have drifted by 3 in each direction
change: derive the text class from the corpus at seed time instead of declaring 15 members in a Python literal. Output delta: same or better (drift becomes impossible); input delta: fewer (one less hand-maintained list); build-cost delta: negligible.
detector: the 1.1 cross-check returns 0 in both directions by construction; output parity on the other 15 classes

what: one provable join instead of four assumed ones: bg_yogas, bg_doshas and bg_dasha_systems each seed identity rows here and keep their own catalogues
change: declare an identity contract between the ontology and the three catalogues — catalogue rows reference the ontology by its composite key. Beyond the layer: the same contract is what L2's fact ids resolve through. Cost: a contract plus three references. Risk: exposes existing mismatches, which is the point.
detector: ablation of seam A: break the identity reference and measure the served reading — today the seam cannot be broken because it is not declared

what: measured: rules per corpus chunk ranges 2.34 (saravali, 471 chunks -> 1101 rules) to 0.08 (bphs, 1459 -> 112) to 0.00 (tajaka_neelakanthi, 290 -> 0) — a 29x spread, with the foundational text near the bottom / required: a declared extraction target per text, and a yield that does not depend on formatting accident
change: per-text structure-aware extraction (deterministic, not LLM per N.4); normalise chunk shape before extracting
detector: rules/chunk per text before and after, plus D1 correspondence on a sample so yield is not bought with precision

what: measured: confidence has 3 distinct values (0.600/0.800/1.000) across 3,002 rows, 2,770 of them 1.000; and confidence = quality_score on 3,002 of 3,002 rows / required: a graded signal that can discriminate, or an honest tier vocabulary, and one field per signal
change: collapse the two columns into one whose vocabulary is the three tiers it actually has
detector: distribution check: one field, named tiers, no duplicate column

what: measured: 3,002 encoded rules, each citing text_id + verse_ref, and no detector compares a rule to its verse / required: D1 source correspondence that can fail
change: build D1 (layer packet W-L0-3) and run it over this asset first — it is the largest encoded-claim set in L0
detector: non-zero mismatch count it could also report as zero; a seeded wrong rule is caught

what: measured: 17 of 3,002 rules carry yoga_canonical_id; 0 of 3,002 carry dasha_system_id / required: a rule names the concept it qualifies
change: populate the concept link; resolve through the ontology's declared key (blocked on pilot-1 O1)
detector: seam-B ablation becomes possible: break the link, measure the served reading

what: measured: exposed through the MCP tool surface (platform-mcp/src/tools/l0_brahmagyan.ts, ref_rules_search) and absent from all 46 L0 retrieval-registry capability modules — 0 of 3,002 rows reachable there / required: reachable from the retrieval registry too, with a density contract
change: add a rules capability to the retrieval registry with a declared density_contract
detector: the exposure census over both surfaces

what: measured: dasha_system_id populated on 0 of 3,002 rows — a column never used / required: populated where the rule is daśā-conditioned, or the column removed
change: populate or drop; an always-null column is a claim nobody makes
detector: count > 0, or the column gone

what: measured: 14 of 15 corpus texts yield rules; tajaka_neelakanthi yields 0 from 290 chunks / required: every ingested text either yields rules or carries a stated reason it cannot
change: extract it, or record inapplicable-with-reason
detector: rules > 0 for all 15, or a recorded reason

what: measured: 2 of 14 rule text_ids (bhrigu_nandi_nadi, bphs_jaimini) have no identity in brahma_ontology's text class / required: every text_id resolves through the controlled set
change: add the two texts to the text class (same fix as pilot 1 G09)
detector: every distinct text_id resolves

what: the largest single value increase available in L0: at saravali's yield BPHS alone would produce ~3,400 rules, more than the entire corpus holds today
change: replace one regex family applied to fifteen differently-formatted texts with per-text structure-aware extraction; keep it deterministic (N.4). Input delta: same corpus. Output delta: elevated. Build-cost delta: higher per run, once.
detector: rules/chunk per text, plus D1 on a sample of new rules
gate: NONE - feeds W-L0-3 and the layer delta

what: one honest signal instead of two identical ones
change: collapse confidence and quality_score; name the three tiers
detector: the distribution after: one field, three tiers

what: L2 could find the doctrine behind a structural claim without re-parsing prose
change: link rules to concepts via the ontology's declared key; depends on pilot-1 O1
detector: seam-B ablation

what: a rate where none exists; O1's cost delta is unmeasurable without it
change: instrument the extractor run (duration, rate) into asset_throughput
detector: rows_per_second non-null

what: measured: body is stored as 'Jupiter'/'Ketu'/'Mars' while brahma_ontology planet canonical_ids are lowercase (jupiter, ketu, mars) — every join from the most-read L0 table to the identity authority passes through an undeclared case normalisation; the asset's integrity_check_sql PINS the capitalised array / required: names resolve through the controlled set, normalisation declared once at the authority
change: normalise at the authority (pilot-1 O1) or rename the column values; the integrity check must move in the same migration
detector: a join census: body resolves to exactly one ontology planet row with no ad-hoc case handling

what: measured: integrity_check_sql asserts shape (exact row count, span, 9-body set, ayanamsha_id='tropical') and never recomputes a position; 825,084 computed values, none independently re-derived / required: D3 re-derivation within a declared tolerance
change: build D3: recompute a sample a second way and compare; seed one error to prove it fails
detector: non-zero mismatch on the seeded case, zero on the corpus

what: measured: asset_throughput.rows_written = 0 for the layer's largest table (825,084 rows), rows_per_second NULL / required: a build record carrying a real figure
change: instrument the COPY path
detector: rows_written non-zero and a rate after one build

what: measured: node_mode holds one value ('true'); mean-node positions are not held, while the schema can express both and the data plane warns against erasing true/mean conventions / required: both conventions, or the choice declared and a mean-node question answered 'unavailable'
change: add mean-node rows (~+825,084) or declare the limit in the release
detector: a mean-vs-true comparison returns two answers, or the release states unavailable with reason

what: measured: 4 capability modules expose it, 0 declare a density_contract / required: declared where the capability paginates or facets
change: declare it on the 4 modules
detector: grep census over the L0 capability directory

what: measured: field-level exposure census NOT RUN for the 4 serving modules / required: measured, not assumed
change: run the exposure census
detector: fields exposed / columns built, per module

what: answers P13 for the node, which today cannot be answered from this table
change: add node_mode='mean' rows, or declare the limit. Input: same source, one more pass. Output: better. Cost: ~2x the table.
detector: a convention comparison returns two answers where it returns one

what: the grain decision taken deliberately once instead of inherited
change: daily granularity means consumers interpolate or recompute intraday. Options: keep daily and declare interpolation the consumer's job; store interpolation coefficients; on-demand Swiss with a cache. Each trades cost against precision in opposite directions.
detector: positional error against a Swiss recomputation at sub-daily times, before and after; cost per query and per rebuild

what: a real second opinion on 825,084 computed values
change: build D3 as a standing check rather than a one-off
detector: the seeded-error proof

what: a baseline for the layer's largest build, without which O2's options cannot be compared
change: instrument the COPY path
detector: a rate in asset_throughput

what: measured: the asset's only status is asset_throughput state='lit' with rows_written=0 — identical to what a writer that produced nothing would write; no liveness or correctness signal exists / required: a status that can return false for a broken service
change: give service assets their own probe: answer a pinned instant, compare to a stored expected limb set
detector: the probe fails when the service is down or wrong

what: measured: no detector recomputes a pañcāṅga limb a second way / required: D3 re-derivation on at least one limb
change: recompute tithi/vāra a second way for a pinned instant and compare
detector: mismatch reported on a seeded wrong convention

what: measured: no census of the service's response fields — completeness (five limbs, each with convention, boundary, precision) and reachability both unmeasured / required: measured, not assumed
change: census the service response and the 4 capability modules
detector: limbs returned / limbs expected; fields exposed / fields returned

what: measured: the registry gives bg_panchanga 0 dependencies while the service cannot compute without ephemeris positions / required: the DAG matches the actual computation path
change: declare bg_panchanga -> bg_ephemeris
detector: the registry edge exists and a topological read places it correctly

what: a service kind the build system can judge, for every service asset in the plane (2 in L0, more above)
change: replace rows_written as the health signal for service assets with a liveness+correctness probe. Cost: one probe per service. Risk: none.
detector: state no longer reads 'lit' for a broken service

what: a declared edge where a real one exists
change: declare the ephemeris dependency
detector: registry DAG matches computation

what: measured: 0 rows of a universe that cannot be declared until a school's passage is in hand (28 nakshatra positions + that passage's vedha pairs) / required: a declared universe once the passage exists
change: ingest the Muhurta Chintamani chapter per the companion seating brief; then declare
detector: the width census becomes computable at all
gate: NONE - blocked on an input, not on effort

what: measured: pre-registered — when seated, cell_value must carry ontology nakshatra ids and school_tag a school id; today there is nothing to check / required: ontology-resolved values at seating time
change: enforce at seating
detector: every seated row resolves through the controlled set

what: activates a waiting consumer with no code change and converts a disclosed approximation into a cited classical grid
change: seat the Muhurta Chintamani grid (native decision 12) once the chapter is ingested; steps in the companion seating brief
detector: ka_vedha_gochara takes the DB-grid path; uncited_extension no longer set for the grid term; every row verse-cited

what: holding two grids is not preferring either — which is what school_tag was designed for
change: after O1, seat a second school_tag and let kala_paddhati_profile select
detector: two schools resolvable; a profile switch changes the vedha reading and nothing else
